ThaiMarketFinds TikTok Content Workflow
1\. Open TikTok
Go to Creator Search Insights.
2\. Search for a Topic
Search keywords related to ThaiMarketFinds, such as:
Thai products
Thailand shopping
Thai skincare
Thailand markets
Thai food
Thailand travel
Thai products to resell
Things to buy in Thailand
3\. Look for Opportunities
Find topics with strong search interest or a Content Gap.
Choose a topic that fits ThaiMarketFinds.
4\. Open AI Canvas
Use the topic you found and go to AI Canvas.
Type what you want to create.
For example:
“Create a TikTok post about 5 Thai skincare products people should know about.”
Use AI Canvas to help generate the post idea, structure, and content.
5\. Create the Post
Turn the idea into your TikTok format:
Slideshow
Product photos
Text on each slide
Quick facts
Faceless video
Shopping footage
Product clips
Market footage
Text overlays
Talking video
Explain the topic
Give recommendations
Answer the question
6\. Use the Information From Creator Search Insights
Creator Search Insights already provides things like:
Recommended keywords
Search terms
Hashtags
Caption suggestions
Search-related information
Use those directly when appropriate instead of creating a separate hashtag/caption strategy.
7\. Add Your ThaiMarketFinds Personality
Make the content more than just information.
Add things like:
Your recommendation
Product opinions
Thailand shopping tips
Sourcing information
Restaurant recommendations
Places to stay
Nearby places to visit
Tips for people traveling to Thailand
8\. Add a CTA
Finish with something that encourages engagement.
Examples:
“Which one would you try?”
“Save this for your Thailand trip.”
“Follow ThaiMarketFinds for more Thailand finds.”
“Want us to find this for you? Send us a message.”
